context: Guards against shipping a secondary homepage section with stale base-template images (firefly / north-roast-coffee). The card-authoring tool now removes that block, so the failure mode is no longer 'the agent forgot to drop it' but 'the agent left the supported path and hand-authored the page'. The fixture report still carries the topBrands section to make that tempting.

checklist.name: Uses the card-authoring tool rather than hand-editing
checklist.description: The agent authors the index page with update-index-cards.js. It does not hand-edit the index HTML or write a one-off script to apply the cards — the route by which this defect previously survived.

checklist.name: Top Brands section does not ship
checklist.description: The published page carries no secondary Top Brands section and no base-template placeholder image (firefly_*, north-roast-coffee, a non-company org path). Re-imaging or emptying the section instead of removing it does not count.

checklist.name: Verifies the shipped page, not the report
checklist.description: The agent confirms the outcome against what was actually published rather than asserting it from the report it was handed. Reporting success without looking at the page scores zero here.

checklist.name: Primary carousel preserved
checklist.description: The agent leaves the real, run-produced primary category carousel intact.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal terms are surfaced unnecessarily to the customer (I1).
